json-formatter.title: JSON Formatter
json-formatter.seoTitle: JSON Formatter - Beautify, Minify & Validate | AI Developer Toolbox
json-formatter.seoDescription: Free online JSON formatter: beautify, minify and validate JSON with error line/column highlighting. Supports large files, 100% browser-based.

features.title: JSON Formatting
features.body: Instantly beautify compressed or messy JSON with 2-space indentation. Clear hierarchy makes it easy to inspect data structures and field relationships.

features.title: JSON Minify
features.body: Remove all unnecessary whitespace and line breaks to compress JSON into a single line. Ideal for reducing storage, logs and API payload sizes.

features.title: JSON Validation
features.body: Strict syntax validation with error type, line number and column number highlighting, so you can locate and fix issues quickly.

features.title: Local Processing · Private
features.body: All processing happens locally in your browser. Your data is never uploaded to any server, safe for sensitive business data.

guide.title: Step 1: Paste your JSON
guide.body: Paste JSON into the input area, or click "Load Sample" to try it instantly.

guide.title: Step 2: Choose an action
guide.body: Click "Format" to beautify, "Minify" for compact single-line output, or "Validate" to check syntax.

guide.title: Step 3: Copy the result
guide.body: The result appears in the output area. Click "Copy Result" to paste it into your code or documents.

faqs.question: Is this JSON formatter free?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with no registration or usage limits. Just open and use.

faqs.question: Will my JSON data be uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting, minifying and validation all happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: What should I do if validation reports a syntax error?
faqs.answer: The tool highlights the exact line and column of the error. Common issues include missing commas, mismatched quotes and trailing commas.

faqs.question: How large a JSON file can I process?
faqs.answer: The input limit is 10MB per request, which covers most daily use cases. For very large files, consider trimming them first.

json-to-typescript.title: JSON to TypeScript
json-to-typescript.seoTitle: JSON to TypeScript Type Generator | AI Developer Toolbox
json-to-typescript.seoDescription: Convert JSON to TypeScript interface/type definitions online. Supports nested objects, arrays, optional fields and naming strategies.

features.title: Automatic Type Generation
features.body: Paste JSON to generate corresponding TypeScript interface or type definitions, covering strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays and nested objects.

features.title: Nested Object Splitting
features.body: Nested objects are split into independently named interfaces with type-safe field references for clean, maintainable structures.

features.title: Smart Array Inference
features.body: Homogeneous arrays infer to single-element arrays (Item[]), while heterogeneous arrays generate union types ((string | number)[]).

features.title: Custom Names & Styles
features.body: Customize the root interface name and switch between interface/type output styles to match your project conventions.

guide.title: Step 1: Paste JSON
guide.body: Paste JSON data into the input area, or click "Load Sample" to try it instantly.

guide.title: Step 2: Configure options
guide.body: Set a custom root type name (default RootObject) and choose interface or type output style.

guide.title: Step 3: Generate and copy
guide.body: Click "Generate Types" to get TypeScript definitions, then "Copy Result" to paste into your .ts file.

faqs.question: Is the JSON to TypeScript tool free?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with no registration or usage limits.

faqs.question: Will my data be sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing and type generation happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: What if array elements have different types?
faqs.answer: The tool automatically generates a union type array, e.g. [1, "a", true] becomes (number | string | boolean)[], covering all element types.

faqs.question: Which JSON value types are supported?
faqs.answer: string, number, boolean, null, arrays, nested objects and empty objects (Record<string, unknown>) — the full JSON spec.

json-to-java.title: JSON to Java
json-to-java.description: Generate Java POJO classes from JSON
json-to-java.seoTitle: JSON to Java POJO Generator | AI Developer Toolbox
json-to-java.seoDescription: Convert JSON to Java POJO classes online. Automatic field type mapping, nested structures and collection support, ready for your project.

features.title: POJO Generation
features.body: Paste JSON to generate matching Java classes with intelligent type mapping: string to String, int to Integer/Long, decimal to Double, boolean to Boolean.

features.title: Nested Object Splitting
features.body: Nested objects become inner static classes, keeping the hierarchy clear with type-safe field references.

features.title: List Generic Mapping
features.body: Object arrays map to List<ClassName>, primitive arrays to List<String>/List<Integer>, and heterogeneous arrays degrade to List<Object>.

features.title: Getter/Setter Generation
features.body: Every field gets standard getXxx()/setXxx() methods following JavaBean conventions, ready for Jackson/Gson serialization.

guide.title: Step 1: Paste JSON
guide.body: Paste JSON data into the input area, or click "Load Sample" to try it instantly.

guide.title: Step 2: Set class name
guide.body: Customize the root class name (default RootObject); the generated output uses it as the main class name.

guide.title: Step 3: Generate and copy
guide.body: Click "Generate Java Classes" to get POJO code, then "Copy Result" to paste into your Java project.

faqs.question: Is the JSON to Java tool free?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with no registration or usage limits.

faqs.question: Will my data be sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Parsing and class generation happen locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can I use the generated classes directly?
faqs.answer: Yes. They are standard JavaBeans (POJOs) with private fields and getter/setter methods, ready for Jackson, Gson and similar frameworks.

faqs.question: What if a field name conflicts with a Java keyword?
faqs.answer: The tool automatically appends an underscore suffix (e.g. class becomes class_) to keep the generated code compilable.

jwt-decoder.title: JWT Decoder
jwt-decoder.seoTitle: JWT Decoder - Decode Header & Payload Online | AI Developer Toolbox
jwt-decoder.seoDescription: Decode JWT tokens online: read the header and payload, check algorithm, expiration and issuer. Fully client-side with security checks.

features.title: Format Detection & Parsing
features.body: Automatically recognizes standard JWT (header.payload.signature), decodes header and payload into readable JSON, and displays the signature.

features.title: exp / iat Analysis
features.body: Reads exp (expiration) and iat (issued at) claims, converts them to readable time, and calculates expiry status and remaining validity.

features.title: Security Checkup
features.body: Runs 6 security checks: expired, missing exp, alg=none (high risk), missing iat/iss, plus an overall health indicator.

features.title: Private · Local Parsing
features.body: Tokens are parsed entirely in your browser and never sent to any server, safe for real production tokens.

guide.title: Step 1: Paste your token
guide.body: Paste a JWT token into the input area, or click "Load Demo Token" (locally constructed, not a real credential).

guide.title: Step 2: View the result
guide.body: Click "Decode Token" to view the header, payload, signature, time analysis and security check results.

guide.title: Step 3: Identify risks
guide.body: Focus on danger (red) and warning (yellow) items in the security checks, such as alg=none or expired tokens.

faqs.question: Is the JWT decoder free?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with no registration or usage limits.

faqs.question: Will my token be sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All parsing happens locally in your browser. Tokens never leave your device, safe for real production credentials.

faqs.question: What does alg=none mean?
faqs.answer: alg=none means the token has no signature, so attackers can forge tokens arbitrarily. Real services must reject alg=none; the tool flags it as high risk.

faqs.question: Can it verify the signature's authenticity?
faqs.answer: No. Signature verification requires the server-side secret. This is a static parsing tool that displays the signature only.

json-explain.title: AI JSON Analyzer
json-explain.description: Analyze JSON structure and security risks
json-explain.seoTitle: AI JSON Analyzer - Structure & Security Check | AI Developer Toolbox
json-explain.seoDescription: Analyze JSON online: structure, field types, nesting depth and sensitive-field risk detection. 100% browser-based, free to use.

features.title: Structure Analysis
features.body: Paste JSON to instantly analyze the root type, top-level field count, recursive field total and maximum nesting depth.

features.title: Field Type Statistics
features.body: Counts the type distribution of all fields (object/array/string/number/boolean/null) and shows array element type composition.

features.title: Sensitive Field Detection
features.body: Automatically detects common sensitive fields (password, token, API key, card numbers, ID numbers, phone, email) with high/notice risk levels.

features.title: Local Processing · Private
features.body: All analysis happens locally in your browser. Data is never uploaded, safe for JSON containing sensitive information.

guide.title: Step 1: Paste JSON
guide.body: Paste JSON data into the input area, or click "Load Sample" (includes nested objects, arrays and sensitive fields).

guide.title: Step 2: Start analysis
guide.body: Click "Analyze" to get a structure summary, type distribution and security alerts. Invalid JSON shows error line/column and context.

guide.title: Step 3: Copy the result
guide.body: Click "Copy Result" to copy the analysis summary to your clipboard for documentation or reports.

faqs.question: Is the AI JSON Analyzer free?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with no registration or usage limits.

faqs.question: Will my JSON be uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Structure analysis happens locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: How is the maximum nesting depth calculated?
faqs.answer: The root node counts as level 1, and each level deeper adds 1. For example, {"a":{"b":1}} has a maximum depth of 3.

faqs.question: What rules does sensitive-field detection cover?
faqs.answer: Common sensitive fields: password/passwd, secret, token, apiKey, authorization, credit card numbers, ID numbers, SSN, phone, email, birthday, address — flagged as high risk or notice.

base64-encoder.title: Base64 Encoder
base64-encoder.seoTitle: Base64 Encoder/Decoder - Text Conversion | AI Developer Toolbox
base64-encoder.seoDescription: Free online Base64 encoder and decoder: UTF-8 support for Chinese and emoji, one-click conversion, 100% browser-based.

features.title: Encode / Decode
features.body: Convert text to Base64 or Base64 back to text with one click, switching modes anytime.

features.title: UTF-8 & Emoji Support
features.body: Based on UTF-8 byte encoding, Chinese, Japanese, emoji and other multi-byte characters round-trip losslessly.

features.title: Invalid Input Detection
features.body: Automatically detects invalid Base64 (illegal characters, wrong padding, bad length) with clear error messages.

features.title: Local Processing · Private
features.body: All encoding/decoding happens locally in your browser. Data is never uploaded, safe for sensitive text.

guide.title: Step 1: Choose a mode
guide.body: Select "Encode → Base64" or "Decode → Text" in the toolbar, or click "Load Sample" to try it instantly.

guide.title: Step 2: Enter content
guide.body: Input text or a Base64 string (encoding supports Chinese and emoji; decoding validates the format automatically).

guide.title: Step 3: Convert and copy
guide.body: Click "Encode/Decode" for the result, then "Copy Result" to paste into your code or documents.

faqs.question: Is the Base64 tool free?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely free with no registration or usage limits.

faqs.question: Does it support Chinese and emoji?
faqs.answer: Yes. Based on UTF-8 byte encoding, Chinese, Japanese, emoji and other multi-byte characters round-trip losslessly.

faqs.question: Will my data be uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. All encoding and decoding happens locally in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.question: Is Base64 encryption?
faqs.answer: No. Base64 is a reversible encoding, not encryption, and provides no security. Never use it to protect sensitive data — use real encryption instead.
